facts.claim: There is a medical school at Hyderabad supported by the State, headed by a Residency Surgeon.
facts.quote: There is also a medical school at Hyderabad, supported by the State, of which the Residency Surgeon is the principial.

facts.claim: An industrial school was established at Aurangabad around 1889 to revive local industries.
facts.quote: The industrial school at Aurangabad was established about 1889, and has done a great deal to revive and improve many industries for which that place was once famous.

facts.claim: In 1901 the schools in Hyderabad contained 650 pupils.
facts.quote: In 1901 these schools con- tained 650 pupils.
